latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of the domain-logic-pattern-selector skill.
- Helps choose between Transaction Script, Domain Model, and Table Module for enterprise application subsystems.
- Provides guidance on deciding Service Layer thickness and avoiding common anti-patterns such as anemic domain model and transaction-script sprawl.
- Designed for software architects, backend engineers, and tech leads working on organizing or refactoring business logic.
- Operates on subsystem descriptions or existing code; delivers a domain-logic pattern decision record with rationale and suggestions.
